name: Sayumi
source:
She is the head of the public morals committee.
She is beautiful, serious, and a good student of both literature and martial arts. 
She is admired by the girls, but behind her back, she is said to be abusive to those who disturb public moral.

Translated from http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1208226
